line-1.text: Hey Mia! I need a book for my vacation. Do you have any suggestions?

line-2.text: Sure! Are you looking for a travel book about your destination, or just something fun?

line-3.text: Just something fun. Maybe a thriller. I love a good cliff-hanger!

line-4.text: I see. I usually read a biography or a self-help book, so I might not be the best person to ask.

line-5.text: Those are great, but sometimes they are hard to follow when I just want to relax.

line-6.text: True. What about a romance novel? I read a really cute one last week. It was a very fast read.

line-7.text: No offense, but I usually think those are trash. I need some action and suspense!

line-8.text: Haha, okay! How about crime fiction? I know a great one about a stolen diamond.

line-9.text: That sounds perfect! Is it available in hardcover? I like collecting them.

line-10.text: Yes, it is! It is very popular, so you can easily find it at the bookstore.
